meta.description: Parse and analyze multiple sequence alignments using Biopython, including conservation, gaps, annotations, weighting, Neff, MI-APC and MUSCLE5 confidence.
meta.note: final pass: fixed and audited under one brief, see CHECKPOINT.md

scientific_integrity.detail: All checked numerical claims came from real data, seeded synthetic truth, or direct independent calculations.

practice_boundaries.detail: The Skill analyzes sequence alignments only and makes no individual diagnostic or treatment claim.

methodological_ground.detail: It guards APC by length and Neff/L, labels shallow rankings as noise, and names estimator dependence.

code_usability.detail: All eleven example modules py_compile; ten executable entrypoints and the fresh Python/WSL workflows ran successfully.

functional_suitability.note: Covers parsing, normalization, annotations, filtering, mapping, weights, Neff, MI-APC, and confidence masking with shipped runnable counterparts.

reliability.note: Normalizes dot/lowercase input, rejects empty filters and invalid weights, and documents format/version limits; malformed external files still rely on Biopython errors.

performance_context.note: References and scripts keep SKILL.md concise; the documented pure-Python Neff/MI loops intentionally target only moderate widths.

agent_usability.note: Clear request-to-reference routing, 0-based convention, runnable paths, and common-error recovery are present.

human_usability.note: Usage prompts and clear CLI patterns are supplied; users still need to choose biologically suitable thresholds.

security.note: No credentials, network side effects, or destructive commands; file paths and regular expressions are passed to trusted Biopython/Python APIs.

maintainability.note: Shared logic is factored into examples/msa_utils.py; references route specialized material and examples supply smoke inputs.

agent_specific.note: Description is specific and the Skill has progressive disclosure and scope handoffs; it could name input-format ambiguity more prominently in the trigger text.

key_strengths: Fresh real-data checks reproduced Pfam normalization, conservation, Neff, and HMMER A2M behavior from the dispatched source copy.
The HMMER unpadded-A2M and MUSCLE5 ensemble paths execute as documented and are guarded by parseable output assertions.
Synthetic tests cover all-gap, zero-weight, case/dot-gap, weighted-consensus, and planted-coupling boundaries.
The source is modular, with runnable examples, a row-filter CLI, and reference files for domain-specific branches.

recommendations.title: Keep MI and Neff use bounded to moderate widths
recommendations.problem: The pure-Python pairwise loops are correct in this audit but scale quadratically with alignment width.
recommendations.root_cause: The examples prioritize transparent implementations over vectorized or compiled kernels.
recommendations.fix: Retain the existing few-hundred-column guidance and direct wider/deeper production contact prediction to plmDCA or EVcouplings as the Skill already recommends.
